title: Next five UI previews (designs approved; playtest pending)
summary: Alfredo approved the five ImageGen design directions and requested the established isolated native-preview workflow. Please review gameplay, rules presentation and UI/QoL before integration. Design approval is not hands-on acceptance; nothing is merged into main.
review_steps: Alfredo approved these design directions; hands-on preview acceptance remains pending. Merging requires Mendon review and required checks. No main merge is authorized by delivery.

Extract the whole ZIP. Start Review.cmd opens Opponent Payment immediately. Quit between demos, then double-click another numbered launcher. No source checkout, SDK or Godot editor is needed. Each opens its prepared review scenario, with a menu or controls for related cases.

Demo 1 — Opponent Payment (#377 / PR #427): choose zero or a legal Gold amount, inspect plain coin symbols, select payment sources, and inspect the immediate outcome. Check the decision owner, Gold restrictions and other-seat presentation. https://github.com/alfredoh7/l5r-emperor/pull/427

Demo 2 — Top Cards (#323 / PR #428): inspect the single row of full card scans, choose their destinations/order, and confirm. No duplicate thumbnail strip or redundant bottom caption. Check private visibility and the published preview cases. https://github.com/alfredoh7/l5r-emperor/pull/428

Demo 3 — Multiple Targets (#345 / PR #429): select on the board or expand independent target groups; check ordered targets, optional zero, attachment selection, alternate costs and reaction cases. https://github.com/alfredoh7/l5r-emperor/pull/429

Demo 4 — Battle Progress (#311 / PR #430): click the five-symbol edge strip to expand the sequence, then return to the current decision. Try declaration/maneuvers, Naval, defender override, forced pass, before-resolution decisions, Encircled Terrain and empty battle. Check decision owners/reasons/pass counts; the strip never submits an action. Infantry uses a distinct helmet. https://github.com/alfredoh7/l5r-emperor/pull/430

Demo 5 — Created Copies (#400 / PR #432): compare the real Gates-created Lion Ancestor with its original. Try battle, bowed stack, an ordinary Personality copy and destruction/removal. The twin-card seal stays outside the full face and existing token rail. Check hover, inspector and public Removed gallery. https://github.com/alfredoh7/l5r-emperor/pull/432

Asterisks in review menus identify synthetic training cases. Record approval or requested changes on the relevant feature PR. Please note UI/QoL feedback for Alfredo with the demo, steps and expected result. Send Feedback.url opens the batch/source PR #432.
known_limitations: Prepared local engine positions are for focused review. They are not full human match acceptance or external multiplayer validation.

This stacked preview includes the previous isolated UI lineage and separately unapproved inherited stabilization/rules/interface candidates. Approving a design does not approve those rules changes; resolve the dependencies with Mendon before integration.

Source includes main through 97d8e407. The public engine contract remains authoritative for choices, ownership, legal targets, Gold, timing and CreatedCopy. The latest five UI tasks do not change authoritative rules; inherited shared changes remain visible in the stack.
Actual Mac native review and automated Windows runtime/launcher validation are separate evidence. Native Windows graphical play and Mendon expert rules acceptance remain pending.
